profiles.default: upstream's unit-test session (core/src/session/tests.rs make_session_and_context): API-key auth, default features, no MCP servers, no extensions, one local environment; the model's catalog entry decides the tool mode
profiles.direct: as default, with the model's tool_mode forced to direct, so every tool that code mode would nest is listed on its own
profiles.all_features_multi_agent_v1: direct, with every feature that core/src/tools/spec_plan.rs reads to register a core tool enabled, update_plan and request_user_input on, sleep always on, multi-agent v1
profiles.all_features_multi_agent_v2: as the previous profile with multi-agent v2

key_order: JSON member order is what serde_json produced in codex-core's test build, where objects come out sorted by key. A release binary built with serde_json's preserve_order feature would send the same members in struct field order. Compare these files as JSON values, not as bytes of a request.
not_captured: Tools contributed by extensions (web search `web.run`, image generation, goals, memories, skills, history notes, agent message board, multi-env file copy): the unit-test session installs no extensions. web_run_description.md and imagegen_description.md are copied as text; their schemas are not captured.
MCP tools, dynamic tools, plugin install tools and `tool_search` contents: they depend on servers and plugins a session has.
Windows variants: the probe ran on Linux, and exec_command adds shell guidance on Windows.
Text assembled at run time around the instructions (environment context, AGENTS.md, permissions): only the template files under source/ are captured.
